authority_basis: Existing human-authorized isolated Pro comparison and planning/implementation review loop; this GO releases one reviewed fixed matrix only.
one_shot: Use the frozen driver.run_models() once; never delete STARTED or retry uncertain execution. Retain failed prefix and not_run tail per frozen contract.
mechanism_interpretation: New scene reads or cache prints of already-delivered in-selection geometry still count as same-class supplements; mark duplicated delivered fields.
Cache computation delivering previously unseen local geometry or shape information counts as supplemental information, but not necessarily fresh scene acquisition.
Only pure computation using complete inputs already delivered to the model is excluded from supplement count and tagged compute-only; all tool cost remains charged.
New out-of-set references or missing triangles remain new information; mixed attempts count as one fully charged call. Fewer real roundtrips requires fewer actual total tool calls.
blinded_review: Return anonymous quality artifacts first. Do not send group cost or adoption conclusions before root quality is sealed. Use a new independent scorer who has not read this cycle's private mapping.
